baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا followed by يُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first verb returns the addressees into a containing locus; ثم orders a second, causative passage from within to without, and the cognate accusative makes emergence the emphatic endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Returning after departure supplies the first transition back into a prior locus.
Passing out from within supplies the second spatial transition, while the repeated verbal root marks its completion.

changed_reading.before: A bare promise that people will come back.
changed_reading.after: A two-phase mechanism: return into the earth's containment, then a deliberately effected and emphatic passage out.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative pronoun in فِيهَا links the return to a place, while causative يُخْرِجُكُمْ presents what that place held.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return is not only repetition but arrival at a return-place; extraction then converts hidden presence in that place into manifest presence outside it.

activation_trace.role: A destination or place and time of return makes فِيهَا the holding destination of the first motion.
Causing a hidden thing to come out turns the second motion into manifestation, not mere relocation.

changed_reading.before: Return and exit are two generic motions.
changed_reading.after: The earth functions as a return-place that holds concealed persons until God brings them into manifest presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُعِيدُكُمْ permits the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping, followed by emphatic extraction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping lets recurrence carry a counted or appointed temporal edge; the following extraction becomes the release that closes that bounded recurrence rather than one turn in an endless cycle.

activation_trace.role: Counted time and recurrence supplies an exploratory schedule-like aspect to the return.
Caused emergence supplies the terminal release from that counted interval.

changed_reading.before: The return is an indefinitely conceived recurrence.
changed_reading.after: The return is provisionally heard as a count-bounded recurrence ending in a decisive re-presentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-postponable appointed term gives the counted-return branch a boundary: return into the earth and extraction from it become phases of a scheduled reconstitution rather than an unlocated recurrence.

activation_trace.role: Counted time and recurrence supplies the focus-side possibility of a scheduled return.
Deferral to a later time, then explicit non-deferral, supplies the limit beyond which the sequence cannot be moved.
The fixed endpoint of a measured term supplies the temporal boundary for return and release.
Causing what is hidden to emerge makes extraction the scheduled sequence's terminal event.

structural_cues: 71:4 repeats the appointed term and says that when it arrives it is not deferred; 71:18 then orders return before extraction with ثم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed term, deferral and non-deferral, and a counted-recurrence branch; I bind that terminus to the focus sequence. A live alternative is that 71:4 bounds mortal life without specifying the timing internal to 71:18.

changed_reading.before: Return and emergence have sequence but no temporal boundary.
changed_reading.after: They form a term-governed reconstitution whose return interval closes in an extraction that cannot be deferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acts and identities of covering sharpen the focus extraction-from-hiding branch: the final خروج is also enforced disclosure, undoing layers by which the addressees made themselves unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Causing a concealed thing to come out anchors the focus as an act of disclosure.
A cover laid over a thing supplies the deliberate concealment that the focus extraction reverses.
Clothing as covering supplies the material layer used to make the self unavailable.
Covering and concealment extend the local act into a durable identity that cannot prevent final disclosure.

structural_cues: 71:7 clusters stopped ears, overlaid garments, persistence, and self-magnification; the branchless finger occurrence supports this as structure but is not cited as a trigger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several covering images and focus-side extraction from hiddenness; I make the arrow from self-concealment to compulsory exposure. The live alternative is a wholly physical resurrection with no disclosure function.

changed_reading.before: God moves bodies from inside the earth to outside it.
changed_reading.after: God also makes concealed persons manifest, reversing the coverings through which they had resisted address.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch-distant recompense that returns to its worker combines with the stated sins and the focus return: re-emergence becomes the point at which consequence returns to its originating actor.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure anchors the movement by which consequence comes back to its source.
Although the context surface denotes garments, its recompense branch supplies an outcome returning to the worker.
Sin and fault identify the humanly generated cause whose consequence can return.
Caused manifestation makes the returned actor available for the returning consequence.

structural_cues: 71:25 places engulfment and entry into fire after the causal phrase مِّمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recompense-return branch, sin, and return into manifestation; I identify resurrection as the occasion on which consequence reaches its actor. The live alternative is that the focus states bodily revival without encoding recompense.

changed_reading.before: The addressees themselves return, with no reciprocal movement specified.
changed_reading.after: Their emergence also enables what issued from them as fault to return to them as consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gushing supply, linked extension, and growth make the rare fiscal branch of إخراج productive: after God sends material into an earth-system and grows life from it, the held human deposit is rendered as that system's commanded output.

activation_trace.role: Copious outflow from a source supplies the first material input to the productive cycle.
A connected increase supplying another thing provides the sustaining input that enables production.
Vegetation coming from the earth supplies the packet's explicit output mechanism.
A due output paid in a known direction recasts emphatic extraction as rendered yield.

structural_cues: 71:11-12 moves from descending supply to extended wealth, offspring, gardens, and rivers; 71:17-18 then moves from human growth out of earth to return and output.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, linked provision, terrestrial growth, and a due-output branch; I join them as a yield mechanism while retaining God as the grammatical agent. The live alternative is that the provision list and resurrection analogy remain separate.

changed_reading.before: Extraction is a one-time spatial removal from earth.
changed_reading.after: Extraction is also heard, exploratorily, as the commanded human yield of a divinely supplied growth system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation, successive states, and layer-after-layer ordering place return and emergence within a repeatable transformation architecture; death is an intervening stage, not a terminal break in making.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies controlled formation rather than accidental change.
Successive stages supply a serial architecture into which return and emergence can enter.
State following state reinforces ordered transition rather than a single static creation.
Doing again after a beginning makes re-creation a repeatable operation.
Caused emergence is the next manifest state produced by the architecture.

structural_cues: 71:14-15 places staged human creation beside layered cosmic creation shortly before the grow-return-extract sequence of 71:17-18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, stages, layers, repetition, and emergence; I treat them as one transformation architecture. The live alternative is that the cosmic layering is evidentiary analogy without specifying a human stage mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection interrupts an otherwise completed creation history.
changed_reading.after: Return and emergence are further ordered stages of the same measured capacity that formed humans through prior states.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding human planting supplies the missing material analogy: return into earth functions as reseeding, and extraction functions as a second germination that reconstitutes what was placed there.

activation_trace.role: Planting and causing growth supplies the deposition-to-emergence mechanism for human reconstitution.
Soft productive earth supplies an active medium capable of receiving and yielding growth.
Returning after an initial departure turns burial-like placement into a repeated growth cycle.
Causing a hidden entity to emerge supplies germination's visible result.

structural_cues: 71:17 immediately precedes the focus and moves humans from earth; 71:18 reverses the vector into it and then repeats the outward vector.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human growth from productive earth and the in-then-out sequence; I map botanical reseeding onto bodily reconstitution. The live alternative is that planting only analogizes first creation and does not describe resurrection's material process.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a passive container from which stored bodies are removed.
changed_reading.after: The earth is a receiving and productive medium: return resembles reseeding and extraction resembles a second germination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Engulfment in water and forced entry into fire provide a negative sequence of enclosures; focus extraction runs the opposite vector, showing that no enclosing medium is final under the agent who transfers persons across its boundary.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive engulfment supplies an enclosure that appears humanly irreversible.
Passage into an interior supplies the inward vector that focus extraction reverses.
Blazing fire identifies the second enclosing state into which the persons are admitted.
Passing from inside to outside supplies the counter-vector and denies enclosure finality.

structural_cues: 71:25 sequences engulfment, then entry into fire, using passive causative forms; 71:18 uses an active causative for emphatic exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced inward transfers and a forced outward transfer; I infer one sovereignty over opposed boundary crossings. The live alternative is that 71:25 describes consequence without revising the physical image in 71:18.

changed_reading.before: Emergence is a natural-looking movement out of soil.
changed_reading.after: Emergence is one direction in a sovereign transfer system where even engulfing water, earth, and fire cannot control their own boundaries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus earth is spread and furnished with penetrable routes and broad openings; this changes extraction from an unexplained vertical burst into passage through a medium whose maker can open and conduct ways through it.

activation_trace.role: Earth as a spread surface supplies the medium in which routes can be laid out.
Penetrating along a route supplies conducted motion through rather than collision with the medium.
An extended traversable way supplies an available exit trajectory.
A broad opening between barriers supplies the aperture through which emergence can be imagined.
Passing out from within anchors the contextual route geometry in the focus motion.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 follows the focus, and its مِنْهَا answers the focus's فِيهَا with movement from the same earth through ways.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spread earth, penetration, ways, and openings; I project that route geometry backward onto extraction. The live alternative is that these paths concern present travel only and do not image resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a closed mass that must simply be breached.
changed_reading.after: The earth is a traversable medium whose maker can conduct emergence through opened ways.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resident and grave-house branches turn return into temporary lodging: the addressees are placed in an earthly abode, but emphatic extraction prevents that abode from becoming permanent ownership or residence.

activation_trace.role: A resident affiliated with a dwelling supplies the social relation of inhabitant to earthly abode.
The grave as a house supplies a temporary lodging image for return into the earth.
A destination or place of return makes the earth an abode reached by the first motion.
Passage out from within terminates residence and makes the lodging provisional.

structural_cues: 71:26 asks that no resident be left upon the earth, while 71:18 places everyone back in it before removing them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resident, grave-house, return-place, and exit images; I cast burial as temporary lodging. The live alternative is that the house and resident branches are lexical echoes too distant to shape the focus.

changed_reading.before: Return into earth is only disposal or storage.
changed_reading.after: Return is temporary inhabitation of a grave-house whose tenure necessarily ends in extraction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the earth-container resemble a gestational body. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus locates return in it and uses causative extraction, while nearby growth and later birth branches supply formation and delivery. Render it only as an analogy and preserve God as agent; do not literalize the earth as mother.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pair يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا and يُخْرِجُكُمْ can support enclosure followed by caused delivery.

activation_trace.role: A return-place supplies the enclosing location in which re-formation is imagined.
Human growth and nurture supplies formation within the analogy.
The event of birth and delivery supplies the cross-domain image for emergence from enclosure.
Causing the hidden to come out anchors the delivery image in the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Earth stores an already fixed body and later releases it.
changed_reading.after: Earth can be carried, cautiously, as an enclosure of renewed formation from which God causes a birth-like emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples an erupting-lesion branch with a wide fissure and sudden discharge. It remains anchored in the emphatic causative خروج and gains a visible release mechanism from the context branch. Render it as a pressure-and-rupture material analogy only, never as a pathological description of resurrected bodies.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled خ ر ج expression can carry a forceful breaking-out image rather than a quiet relocation.

activation_trace.role: An abscess breaking out supplies pressure-driven emergence through a containing surface.
A wide split and release supplies the rupture by which the containing earth opens.
A sudden abundant discharge supplies the force and multiplicity of emphatic collective extraction.

changed_reading.before: Emergence is smooth passage through a ready opening.
changed_reading.after: Emergence may be pictured as pressure released when the containing surface is made to split widely and discharge its contents.

strongest_changes: The immediate growth-from-earth context revises passive storage into reseeding and germinative reconstitution.
Measured stages, layered states, and the appointed non-deferred term turn resurrection into an ordered and bounded continuation of creation.
Covering, engulfment, entry, and opened routes make extraction both compulsory disclosure and sovereign boundary crossing.
summary.what_was_special: The split ع و د mapping introduced counted recurrence, while branch-distant images of recompense, productive output, residence, and grave-house exposed temporal, legal, material, and social mechanisms that a generic resurrection gloss would collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not determine how long the interval marked by ثم lasts.
The agricultural, lodging, gestational, and rupture mechanisms may be analogical rather than descriptions of resurrection's material process.
The non-dominant ع د د mapping and the ث و ب recompense branch are live activations but remain especially branch-distant from their focus and context surfaces.
